ratio = x / y
best_pair = (0, 1)
min_diff = float('inf')

for b in range(1, n + 1):
    val = ratio * b
    a_floor = int(val)
    a_ceil = a_floor + 1

    diff_floor = abs(ratio - a_floor / b)
    diff_ceil = abs(a_ceil / b - ratio)

    if diff_floor < min_diff:
        min_diff = diff_floor
        best_pair = (a_floor, b)
    if diff_ceil < min_diff:
        min_diff = diff_ceil
        best_pair = (a_ceil, b)
